start.speaker: Kristin
start.text: There you are. You look tired.

choices.text: I went to see my parents.

shift.speaker: Kristin
shift.text: Sit with me a bit. How are your parents?

choices.text: I went to see them today.

parents.speaker: Kristin
parents.text: In the facility? How are they?

choices.text: Happy, I think. Same as always.

fine.speaker: Kristin
fine.text: Then everything is OK, Igor. Look at the city.
